neighbours.label: In Russian (and Korean), a verb stem piece just before its infinitive or verbal ending (н|азв|ать, объ|ясн|ить, по|сет|ить, 시작|하기), i.e. a predictor of the verb ending, not Russian words that are not split infinitives.
